SELECT pages.id, pages.source_id, pages.slug, trust_tier, write_origin, ((CASE pages.trust_tier WHEN 'user_confirmed' THEN 6 WHEN 'operator_curated' THEN 5 WHEN 'tool_observed' THEN 4 WHEN 'agent_written' THEN 3 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'external_untrusted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <= 3
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM write_gate_receipts elig_r WHERE elig_r.target_table = 'pages' AND elig_r.target_id = pages.id::text
      AND elig_r.verdict = 'flag' AND elig_r.reason_families && ARRAY['standing_instruction','override','exfiltration','credential']::text[])) AS flagged,
  (COALESCE(s.config->>'guest' = 'true', false) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guest_sources gs WHERE gs.source_id = pages.source_id)) AS guest,
  CASE WHEN (COALESCE(s.config->>'guest' = 'true', false) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guest_sources gs WHERE gs.source_id = pages.source_id)) THEN 'external' WHEN (pages.type = 'rule' OR (pages.type = 'facts' AND pages.frontmatter->>'claims' = 'allowed')) AND NOT (pages.trust_tier = 'external_untrusted' OR (pages.trust_tier = 'agent_written' AND COALESCE(pages.write_origin->>'channel', '') NOT LIKE 'cli:%')) AND COALESCE(s.config->>'precedence', '') NOT IN ('record', 'external') THEN 'approved'
    WHEN s.config->>'precedence' IN ('record', 'approved', 'curated', 'doc', 'chat', 'external') THEN s.config->>'precedence'
    WHEN pages.source_id IN ('conversations', 'conversations-owner') OR s.config->>'kind' IN ('meetings', 'google') THEN 'chat'
    ELSE 'curated' END AS precedence
  FROM pages LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.id = pages.source_id WHERE pages.id = ANY($1::int[])
